title: Konflux UI Segment Events
description: Union of all Konflux UI analytics event types

CommonFields.description: Base fields required on every Segment event sent from Konflux UI

sessionId.description: Random UUID generated in memory for the current browser tab; regenerated for each tab

user_login_event.description: Fired when a user successfully authenticates into Konflux

user_logout_event.description: Fired when a user session ends, either by explicit logout or session expiry

JourneyStep.description: A single step (page visit) within a user's navigation journey

pagePattern.description: Route pattern of the page, e.g. /ns/:workspaceName/applications. Must be the route pattern, not the resolved URL — never include workspace/tenant names or other identifiers from the actual path.

durationMs.description: Time in milliseconds the user spent on this step

toPagePattern.description: Route pattern the user navigated to after leaving this step. Absent on the last (still-open) step. Must be the route pattern, not the resolved URL.

hiddenMs.description: Total milliseconds the browser tab was hidden (backgrounded) while the user was on this step. Allows computing active dwell time as durationMs - hiddenMs. Only present when greater than 0.

user_journey_event.description: Fired once per session, or once per part when the payload is auto-split, capturing the navigation path and per-page dwell times

sessionStartedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the session started

totalDurationMs.description: Duration of this journey part in milliseconds. For auto-split journeys, each part reports the duration of its own session segment rather than the full journey.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps (page visits) taken during the session

journeyId.description: Stable identifier linking all parts of a split journey. Only present when auto-split fires (payload exceeded size threshold).

journeyPartIndex.description: Zero-based index of this part within a split journey. Only present when auto-split fires.

feedback_submitted_event.description: Fired when a user submits feedback through the Konflux UI

rating.description: User satisfaction rating, typically on a 1-5 scale

feedback.description: Free-text feedback provided by the user

email.description: Optional contact email provided by the user for follow-up

ui_session_started_event.description: Fired once per browser tab on the first app load, regardless of auth state, to capture how the user arrived at Konflux UI

arrivalSource.description: Classification of document.referrer on first load, e.g. 'github' if the referrer host is github.com (or a subdomain).

feature_flags_changed_event.description: Fired every time the Feature Flag Panel modal is closed. Contains only the flags whose effective state changed between panel open and panel close. changesCount may be 0 when user opened the panel but did not change anything (tracks panel awareness).

changes.description: Map of changed flag keys to their new boolean value. Empty object if no flags were changed.

changesCount.description: Number of flags that changed. 0 means the user opened the panel but did not change anything.

pagePattern.description: Route pattern when the panel was opened (e.g. /ns/:workspaceName/applications), never the resolved URL
